content: We have simulated a combined topology with 6 resistors: R1,R2 from subnet1 (10,20) between A and X1 (both in parallel). Subnet2 originally had 4 resistors (R1..R4) but we need to map them to new IDs to avoid conflict. We used R3,R4,R5,R6 for those values (20,15,10,5) connecting B->N_b3, N_b3->N_b2, N_b2->N_b3? Actually connections: B-N_b3 (R3=20), N_b3-N_b2 (R4=15), N_b2-N_b1 (R5=10), N_b1-X1 (R6=5). This matches subnet2 chain from B to X1 via N_b3,N_b2,N_b1. The simulated resistances match all given measurements (we saw A-B 56.667, A-X1 6.667, A-N_b1 11.667, A-N_b2 21.667, A-N_b3 36.667, B-N_b1 45, B-N_b2 35, B-N_b3 20, B-X1 50, N_b1-N_b2 10, N_b1-N_b3 25, N_b1-X1 5, N_b2-N_b3 15, N_b2-X1 15, N_b3-X1 30). Let's verify a few more: we haven't simulated N_b1-N_b2 etc. But likely correct because series/parallel combos produce those values. Let's test one more: N_b1 to N_b2 should be 10 (R5). Simulate.
